beats.say: On Wednesday 26 May 1999, Manchester United faced Bayern Munich in a dramatic final.
The match took place exactly on what would have been Matt Busby's ninetieth birthday.
Earlier that month on 16 May, United claimed the Premier League title.
They then beat Newcastle United in the FA Cup Final on 22 May.
Finally, Manchester United beat Bayern Munich two to one to seal an unforgettable treble.

facts: The 1999 UEFA Champions League final was played on 26 May 1999.
Manchester United beat Bayern Munich 2 to 1 in the final.
Matt Busby died in 1994 and the day of the final would have been his 90th birthday.
Manchester United claimed the Premier League title on 16 May.
Manchester United beat Newcastle United in the 1999 FA Cup Final on 22 May.
